title: app: no capabilities file — the webview is granted nothing, so job_updated events are ACL-denied and the UI never updates live (e2e #71: row frozen at probing while the engine uploaded 24 MiB)
body:
## Symptom (CI run #71, app-e2e — after #39's fix landed)

The #39 fix is proven by wire truth: the session survived the Upload click and the loopback recorder shows `tus_sessions: 1, tus_bytes: 25165824` — **the full 24 MiB file went through the real shell via the tus adapter**. The engine worked. The e2e still failed:

```
job A running: "row never reached `running` (pct cap None); last state=probing pct=0"
```

For the whole 30 s poll the row text stayed `probing` and the percent stayed `0` — while the recorder collected all 24 MiB and the job (by journal truth) must have gone Running → Finishing → Done. The UI never received a single `job_updated` snapshot.

## Root cause

`ium-app/src-tauri/` has **no `capabilities/` directory at all**. Tauri v2's ACL
(https://v2.tauri.app/security/capabilities/):

> "By default, all commands that you registered in your app (using the
> tauri::Builder::invoke_handler function) are allowed to be used by all the
> windows and webviews of your app."

That is why every `invoke()` works (form, stat_file, create_job — the upload ran).
But the frontend event API (`listen` from `@tauri-apps/api/event`) is a CORE PLUGIN
command (`plugin:event|listen`) and is **permission-gated** — the docs' own example
capability lists `core:event:default` among the required grants. With no capability
file the webview is granted nothing, so in `App.tsx` the `listen("job_updated", …)`
promise rejects (an unhandled rejection — silent), the snapshot stream never
connects, and the row renders only the one `list_jobs` snapshot taken at creation.

The same gap breaks the `Choose file…` picker for real users: `@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog`
is a plugin too (`dialog:default` required). The e2e only dodged it via the paste-a-path seam.

Why no unit test caught it: vitest tests the UI logic with mocks; the ACL is a
build-time webview grant, only observable in a running shell — exactly the class
the #35 e2e exists to catch (and it did, on its third enabled step).

## Fix

`ium-app/src-tauri/capabilities/default.json`: identifier `default`, window `main`,
permissions `core:default` (includes `core:event:default` — the job_updated stream —
plus the window/path/app defaults) and `dialog:default` (the picker).

RED evidence = run #71's app-e2e log (row frozen at `probing pct=0` for 30 s while
the recorder records `tus_bytes: 25165824`); GREEN = the same lane reaching
running → live progress → pause/resume → done → inspect → cancel.
